mods.name: Aurora
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Frosted glass over a slow aurora gradient. Translucent panels, soft 14px corners, a violet glow that follows what you hover. Heavier on the GPU than a flat theme.

mods.name: Avatar Downloader
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Download a member's profile picture at the highest quality Slack stores — the original upload when there is one, otherwise the largest rendition. Adds a button to the profile pane and to the hover actions on a message.

settings.label: Size to save
settings.hint: Slack keeps a few. Original is whatever was uploaded, which is not always the biggest.

mods.name: Channel Notes
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: A private scratchpad per channel, opened from a button in the channel header. Notes are stored locally and never sent anywhere. Doubles as the worked example of the BetterSlack widget API.

mods.name: Cocoa
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: A warm, low-contrast light theme: cream paper, cocoa text, generous 18px corners and soft shadows instead of borders. Easy on the eyes for a long day of reading.

mods.name: Code Highlight
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Colours the code blocks in messages, and works out which language they are on its own -- Slack sends them as plain grey text with no way to say what they contain. Twenty-one languages, from JSON and SQL to GraphQL, Dockerfiles and diffs, and it leaves a block alone when it is not sure.

mods.name: Command Palette
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Slack's quick switcher with everything else in it: jump to any conversation, find anyone in the workspace, run any mod's commands, and switch or configure your mods -- all from one keystroke, with / @ # to narrow it down. Bind it to as many shortcuts as you like, taken from Slack if Slack had them.

settings.label: Shortcuts
settings.hint: One or more, separated by commas -- mod+k, mod+shift+p. `mod` is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere. Whatever you bind is taken from Slack if Slack had it: the palette listens before the app does. Easier from the palette itself: run "Change the shortcuts" and press the keys.

mods.name: Composer Character Count
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Shows a live character count under the message composer, and warns before you cross Slack's 4000-character limit and get split into two messages.

settings.label: Warn above
settings.hint: Characters. Slack itself starts splitting messages around 4000.

settings.label: Always show the count
settings.hint: Off: it stays out of the way until you are near the warning.

mods.name: Copy Message Link
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: One-click permalink copy in the hover actions, instead of opening the overflow menu and hunting for Copy link. Confirms with a small toast.

mods.name: DevTools
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Opens and closes Slack's real Chrome DevTools — console, elements, network, the lot — from a button above the BetterSlack one. Same action as Slack's own hidden ⌘⌥I menu item.

mods.name: Discord Dark
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Slack rebuilt as Discord: colours sampled from the real client, round server icons with the sliding pill, and Discord's sidebar. Brings in the member column and account strip as plugins.

mods.name: Discord Light
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Slack wearing Discord's default light theme: white chat on grey chrome, blurple accent, gg sans type stack, 8px corners and circular avatars.

mods.name: Focus Mode
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F to fold away the sidebar, the rail and the top bar, leaving just the conversation on a narrower, centred column. Press again to bring it all back.

mods.name: Focus Rings
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Thicker, higher-contrast keyboard focus outlines everywhere in Slack. Useful if you drive Slack from the keyboard or lose the cursor on a large screen.

mods.name: Full Links
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Keeps long links whole. Slack shortens a long URL to its host and an ellipsis -- in the messages you read, and in the ones you send, since the short label is stored in the message itself. This puts both back: it restores what is on screen, and stops the label being made when you paste.

mods.name: Member Sidebar
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: A column of the current channel's members down the right of the message pane, split into online and offline, where clicking someone opens their Slack profile.

settings.label: Members to list
settings.hint: Slack pages the member list beyond this. Higher costs one request per extra person.

settings.label: Availability lookups
settings.hint: users.getPresence is one request each and rate-limits around fifty a minute. Past this, everyone is still listed, without dots.

mods.name: Midnight
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: A deeper, cooler dark theme. Overrides Slack's design tokens rather than its class names, so it keeps working across Slack updates.

mods.name: Motion
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Slack, with the frames in between: conversations that fade in instead of snapping, dialogs and menus that arrive on a spring, reactions that pop, and hover and press feedback on everything you point at. It covers the components the plugin API hands out too, so every mod's own interface moves with the app. Five families you can switch off one by one, and speed and amplitude on dials.

settings.label: Speed
settings.hint: Percent. 100 is the tuned default, 200 twice as quick, 50 half. Everything scales together, so the app keeps one tempo.

settings.label: Amplitude
settings.hint: Percent. How far things travel and how much they scale. 0 keeps every fade and removes every movement; 150 is noticeably theatrical and still readable.

settings.label: Views
settings.hint: Switching conversation brings the message pane in from below, changing section inside a dialog brings its panel in, and the rail's active tab settles into place.

settings.label: Dialogs and menus
settings.hint: Dialogs, menus and the command palette arrive on a spring from the corner they belong to; the thread pane slides in from the edge.

settings.label: Hover
settings.hint: Colours ease instead of snapping, sidebar rows lean towards the pointer, avatars and reactions answer it, a message's hover actions fade in, and the sidebar's selection cross-fades from row to row.

settings.label: Press
settings.hint: Buttons acknowledge being pressed. Short and shallow: this is meant to be felt rather than watched.

settings.label: Arrivals
settings.hint: Small things that appear in place pop into it instead of blinking: a reaction someone just added, the jump-to-unread pill, a tooltip.

mods.name: Quote Reply
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Adds a Reply button to the hover actions on a message. It drops a link to that message into the composer as a single "." and focuses it, so your answer posts in the channel with Slack's own preview of the message you are answering.

mods.name: Sidebar Account Strip
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Your avatar, name and availability at the bottom of the channel sidebar, the way Discord and other chat apps put them; clicking it opens Slack's own account menu.

mods.name: Terminal
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Slack as a phosphor terminal: monospace everywhere, zero rounded corners, hairline borders, amber and green on near-black. Square avatars included.

mods.name: Theme Builder
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: A theme workbench in its own window, with the real Slack beside it as the preview: two colours become twelve roles across all four token families, point at anything in the app to see and edit the tokens that paint it, search every colour the client defines, and add CSS of your own on top.

mods.name: User Inspector
mods.author: AirOne-dev
mods.description: Shows everything Slack's API knows about a member — roles, timezone, presence, do-not-disturb, custom fields and every avatar size — as extra sections inside their profile, styled like Slack's own. Read-only; nothing leaves your machine.
